unitsData.title: Discovering Art in Our World
unitsData.description: Exploring art all around us - in nature, our classroom, and our community. Introduction to basic art materials and techniques.
unitsData.bigIdeas: Art is everywhere around us. We can create art with many different materials.
unitsData.essentialQuestions: ["Où voyons-nous l'art?","Qu'est-ce qui fait quelque chose beau?","Comment puis-je créer de l'art?"]
unitsData.assessmentPlan: Art observation journals, exploration portfolios, material experimentation documentation, peer sharing circles.
unitsData.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Exploration focus, large tools, sensory experiences, process over product","developing":"Guided techniques, choice of materials, skill building activities","extending":"Complex projects, teaching others, art research, gallery creation"}
unitsData.culminatingTask: Create an "Art in My World" collection showcasing found art and personal creations.
lessonPlanTitles: Art Discovery: Art All Around Us
Art Discovery: Lines and Shapes in Art

unitsData.title: Winter Celebrations Through Art
unitsData.description: Creating art for winter celebrations, exploring cultural traditions through visual arts, and making gifts and decorations.
unitsData.bigIdeas: Art helps us celebrate special times. Different cultures celebrate in beautiful ways.
unitsData.essentialQuestions: ["Comment l'art rend-il les célébrations spéciales?","Quelles traditions artistiques existe-t-il?","Comment puis-je créer de l'art pour partager?"]
unitsData.assessmentPlan: Cultural art research presentations, gift creation process documentation, decoration portfolios, celebration art showcase.
unitsData.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Simple decorations, template support, partnered projects, celebration choice","developing":"Original designs, cultural research, multi-step projects, peer collaboration","extending":"Complex techniques, teaching others, cultural art fusion, gallery curation"}
unitsData.culminatingTask: Winter celebration art gallery featuring student-created decorations and gifts.

unitsData.title: Textures and Patterns
unitsData.description: Exploring texture through printmaking, collage, and mixed media. Creating patterns inspired by nature and culture.
unitsData.bigIdeas: Texture adds interest to art. Patterns are everywhere and can tell stories.
unitsData.essentialQuestions: ["Comment puis-je créer différentes textures?","Où voyons-nous des motifs dans notre monde?","Comment les motifs racontent-ils des histoires?"]
unitsData.assessmentPlan: Texture exploration journals, pattern creation portfolios, printmaking process documentation, mixed media experiments.
unitsData.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Simple patterns, texture exploration, large print tools, tactile focus","developing":"Complex patterns, varied textures, printmaking techniques, layering","extending":"Cultural pattern research, teaching printmaking, texture innovation, pattern mathematics"}
unitsData.culminatingTask: Create a textured pattern quilt square for a collaborative class quilt.
lessonPlanTitles: Textures & Patterns: Touch and See Art

unitsData.title: Our Art Gallery
unitsData.description: Celebrating our growth as artists, curating exhibitions, and reflecting on our artistic journey throughout the year.
unitsData.bigIdeas: We are all artists. Art galleries help us share and celebrate art with our community.
unitsData.essentialQuestions: ["Comment ai-je grandi comme artiste?","Comment présenter mon art aux autres?","Pourquoi l'art est-il important?"]
unitsData.assessmentPlan: Portfolio conferences, artist statements, gallery presentation skills, peer appreciation feedback, growth documentation.
unitsData.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Supported selection, simple statements, paired presentations, celebration focus","developing":"Independent curation, detailed statements, gallery roles, peer support","extending":"Gallery design leadership, mentoring others, critical appreciation, future goals"}
unitsData.culminatingTask: Student-curated art gallery exhibition for families and community.

unitsData.title: Colors and Feelings
unitsData.description: [ARCHIVED - Not in rotation schedule] Exploring how colors express emotions and ideas. Learning color mixing and creating art that communicates feelings.
unitsData.bigIdeas: Colors can show how we feel. Artists use colors to tell stories and share emotions.
unitsData.essentialQuestions: ["Comment les couleurs nous font-elles sentir?","Comment puis-je montrer mes sentiments avec l'art?","Quelles couleurs vont bien ensemble?"]
unitsData.assessmentPlan: Color exploration experiments, emotion artwork portfolios, color mixing documentation, artist statements.
unitsData.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Primary colors focus, large brushes, feeling cards support, process emphasis","developing":"Color mixing exploration, emotion-color connections, varied tools","extending":"Color theory introduction, complex emotions, teaching color mixing, artist research"}
unitsData.culminatingTask: Create a "Feelings Rainbow" artwork showing different emotions through color choices.

unitsData.title: Stories in Art
unitsData.description: [ARCHIVED - Not in rotation schedule] Using visual art to tell stories, illustrate books, and communicate ideas through sequential art and illustration.
unitsData.bigIdeas: Art can tell stories without words. We can be illustrators and visual storytellers.
unitsData.essentialQuestions: ["Comment l'art raconte-t-il une histoire?","Comment puis-je illustrer mes idées?","Qu'est-ce qui fait une bonne illustration?"]
unitsData.assessmentPlan: Story illustration portfolios, visual narrative sequences, character design documentation, peer story interpretations.
unitsData.differentiationStrategies: {"emerging":"Single scene illustrations, story dictation with art, character templates, partner work","developing":"Multi-scene stories, original characters, book format exploration, peer collaboration","extending":"Complex narratives, teaching illustration, digital storytelling, author-illustrator study"}
unitsData.culminatingTask: Create and publish a class illustrated storybook featuring student artwork.
